title: RTEC Spanish-language transit brochure and LEP publication history

sources.content_role: Attachment divider/embedded-image wrapper for Spanish brochure.

sources.source: R12 spanish brochure RESPONSABILIDADES DEL PASAJERO2 minor change.doc

sources.content_role: Transmittal stating additional Safe Harbor information had been added to RTEC's Title VI/LEP plan at KYTC/OTD request.

currentness_risks: The brochure contains historical service areas, service descriptions, hours, web domain and program language that must not be republished as current without reconciliation.
The source uses the historical www.4rtec.com domain.
Some passenger-policy statements may have changed with current ADA, safety, service-area or operational policy.
The Spanish copy itself should be professionally/currently validated before reuse; preservation of the historical source does not establish translation quality.
durable_process: Title VI/LEP plan attachments include translated public-facing service material as evidence of language-assistance implementation.
Changes to English service rules/contact information should trigger a linked review/update of translated brochures, website content and vehicle/public notices.
State-requested Safe Harbor updates should be retained with the plan/submission correspondence that caused the change.
automation_candidate: Maintain one canonical multilingual content dataset for service areas, contacts, hours, rider rules and accommodation/language-assistance statements, then render English/Spanish web and print outputs from the same versioned source.
